entries.zh: 欺；欺负、凌辱（agrauiar：亏待、苛待他人）
entries.en: to wrong; to injure, aggrieve

entries.zh: 欺负；亏待、苛待
entries.en: to wrong, mistreat; to take unfair advantage of

entries.zh: 欺凌；恃强凌辱
entries.en: to bully; to insult and mistreat (escarneçer: to mock, deride)

entries.zh: 欺压；压迫苛待
entries.en: to oppress; to wrong by crushing (oprimir: to oppress)

entries.zh: 以大欺小；欺负谋算弱小者（原西语注「长者欺幼者」）
entries.en: for the greater to wrong the lesser; to bully and scheme against the weak

entries.zh: 凌；凌辱、欺凌
entries.en: to insult, outrage (afrentar: to affront); to mistreat

entries.zh: 得罪我、亏待我（「agrauiome」=他亏待了我；封存件汉字作「開我」，字形疑有讹）
entries.en: he wronged me; he mistreated me
entries.notes: 汉栏「開我」与西语 agraviome 及闽南 cúy gùa（亏/摧?）不甚吻合，依词头释义定夺

entries.zh: 亏心事；违背良心之事（西语注「虚构诬陷」）
entries.en: a thing against one's conscience; a false accusation raised (leuantar falso)

entries.zh: 亏失；亏欠、损失
entries.en: loss, detriment; to wrong by depriving

entries.zh: 亏我、亏待我（agrauiome：他亏欠了我）
entries.en: he wronged me; he did me an injustice

entries.zh: 殴；殴打（作为亏待、加害手段）
entries.en: to beat; to strike as an injury

entries.zh: 殴辱；殴打羞辱
entries.en: to beat and insult; to abuse physically and affront

entries.zh: 殴蛮；蛮横冒犯、无理殴打（西语注「冒犯、得罪」）
entries.en: to offend rudely; to wrong with insolence (ofender: to offend)

entries.zh: 害；损害、加害
entries.en: to harm; to injure, do damage to

entries.zh: 歆我（agrauiome：他亏待了我；「歆」本义羡求，此处用字与词头义不合，存疑）
entries.en: he wronged me (character 歆 reads oddly here; gloss per headword)
entries.notes: 汉栏「歆我」与西语 agraviome 不符，或为原稿音写借字，释义依西语词头

entries.zh: 歪；歪曲、行事不正（引申为亏待不公）
entries.en: crooked, unjust; to deal unfairly

entries.zh: 枉屈；冤枉屈待、以不义亏待人（西语注明「以不义相欺」）
entries.en: to wrong unjustly; to twist and oppress (con injusticia: with injustice)

entries.zh: 枉人；冤枉人、委屈亏待人
entries.en: to wrong a person; to do someone an injustice

entries.zh: 负；辜负、亏负
entries.en: to fail (someone), treat unfairly; to wrong

entries.zh: 负义；忘恩负义（西语注「负义而失礼无恩」）
entries.en: to betray what is right; ingratitude, breaking faith

entries.zh: 强；强行亏待、以力相强（西语注「以强力加害」）
entries.en: to wrong by force; to overpower (tomando por fuerça: taking by force)

entries.zh: 强挟人；以强力挟制、强迫他人
entries.en: to coerce a person by force; to constrain and wrong someone forcibly
